works.background: A single block of breccia tuff cut into a square column and inscribed on all four faces with Chinese characters in clerical script: 44 lines, 1,775 characters in all, of which about 1,590 remain legible. The text gives the founding legend of Koguryo, the deeds of King Gwanggaeto, and the allocation of 330 households of tomb guards. It was designated a national key cultural relic in 1961 together with the Donggou tomb complex.
works.backgroundZh: 碑以角砾凝灰岩略加修琢成方柱形，四面环刻汉字隶书：通计四十四行、一千七百七十五字，可辨识者约一千五百九十字。碑文记高句丽建国传说、好太王功业及三百三十户守墓烟户的摊派。1961 年随洞沟古墓群公布为第一批全国重点文物保护单位。

review.note: Draft record from two entries of the Jilin provincial gazetteer read on 2026-11-23. They agree on height, line count and character total. The stone was not examined and no rubbing was consulted; the reading of individual characters is not addressed.

notes: The gazetteer's older entry counts 44 lines of 41 characters per full line; the newer entry gives 44 lines and 1,775 characters. The two are consistent, but neither states how many characters a full line holds on each face.
The stele is often called 好大王碑 in modern writing; the project keeps 好太王碑 as the title and records the other form as an alias.
The inscription's historical geography and its bearing on early fifth-century relations are not summarised here; only what the gazetteer states is recorded.
notesZh: 方志旧条目记四十四行、满行四十一字，新条目记四十四行、一千七百七十五字；二者相合，但均未逐面说明满行字数。
今人常写作「好大王碑」；本项目以「好太王碑」为条名，别写存为别名。
碑文所涉历史地理及五世纪初的对外关系，此处不作概述；只录方志明言者。

works.background: Wang Xianzhi's copy of Cao Zhi's fu survived only in part: the hemp-paper original was already damaged by the Song. The stone was lost, rediscovered at 葛岭 in the Wanli period, entered the Qing court under Kangxi, left it after 1900, and was bought for the Beijing cultural relics shop in 1981 and transferred to the Capital Museum.

works.background: The Palace Museum describes this as the earliest surviving authenticated letter by a named Western Jin master: nine lines written with a worn brush on hemp paper. It passed through the Song imperial collection, the Ming collectors Han Shineng and Zhang Chou, the Qing collections of An Qi and the Qianlong court, and the household of Prince Gong; Zhang Boju and Pan Su gave it to the state in 1956.
works.backgroundZh: 故宫称此帖为现存年代最早、真实可信的西晋名家法帖：秃笔书于麻纸，凡九行。此帖宋代入宣和内府，明代经韩世能、张丑，清代经安岐、乾隆内府，后归恭王府；1956 年张伯驹、潘素夫妇捐献国家。

review.note: Draft record from the Palace Museum collection entry read on 2026-11-23. The museum's character count, the writing support and the transmission chain are recorded as it states them; the scroll itself was not examined. The character count differs between accounts and is left unresolved.
review.noteZh: 草稿记录，依据 2026-11-23 阅读的故宫藏品页面整理。字数、书写材料与递藏链条均照馆方所记；未核对原件。字数各家不一，未作裁断。

notes: The museum gives 9 lines and 86 characters and calls the script 草隶书; the wording is kept rather than converted to 章草 or 草书.
The transmission chain from the Song imperial collection to 1956 is summarised from the museum's own paragraph; no intermediate owner is dated there.
The record does not assert a writing year: the museum places the letter in the Western Jin without one.
notesZh: 馆方记九行八十六字，书体作「草隶书」；本记录照录，不改称章草或草书。
自宋内府至 1956 年的递藏依馆方段落概述；该段未给中间各家系年。
本记录不主张书写年份：馆方只系于西晋，未给具体年。

attribution.note: The text was written by the late Song–early Yuan literatus Mou Yan; Zhao Mengfu copied it.

attribution.name: 赵孟頫

compositionDate.note: The museum dates the scroll to fourteenth-century Yuan and states that no writing year is recorded. The national database infers an age of 49 to 56 from the text and Zhao Mengfu's offices; that inference is not converted into a year here.

works.background: Zhao Mengfu's draft for the stele recording the repair of the three gates of the Xuanmiao Abbey in Suzhou, a Daoist temple founded in the Western Jin. Mou Yan wrote the text and Zhao Mengfu copied it, adding a seal-script heading at the front. The museum notes that the writing follows the manner of the Tang calligrapher Li Yong.
works.backgroundZh: 此为苏州玄妙观重修三门所立碑之文稿。玄妙观始建于西晋，元代重修三门并立碑；记文由牟巘撰写，赵孟頫誊写并篆额。馆方称其运笔以唐李邕为法。

review.note: Draft record from the Tokyo National Museum collection record and the ColBase national database entry, read on 2026-11-23. Neither gives a writing year, dimensions or an accession date; the scroll was not examined.
review.noteZh: 草稿记录，依据 2026-11-23 阅读的东京国立博物馆藏品著录与 ColBase 国家数据库条目整理。两处均未记书写年份、尺寸与入藏年份；未核对原卷。

notes: The scroll is the draft, not the stele. The record does not claim that the stone survives.

works.background: A court compendium of calligraphy from the Three Kingdoms to the Ming, carved in 32 volumes on 艾叶青石 by order of the Qianlong Emperor. The 1747 order and the 1750 colophon bracket the work. It is named after the three Wang treasures kept in the Hall of Three Rarities beside the Hall of Mental Cultivation, and the finished stones were set into the walls of the Yuegu Lou pavilion in Beihai Park.
works.backgroundZh: 清乾隆年间宫廷编刻的大型丛帖，收三国至明历代法书，分三十二卷，刻于艾叶青石。乾隆十二年（1747）上谕编刻，十五年（1750）大臣刻跋，前后相衔。帖名取自养心殿西暖阁「三希堂」所藏三件王氏墨迹；刻成后帖石嵌于北海阅古楼壁间。

review.note: Draft record from two Palace Museum entries and a China Daily feature read on 2026-11-23. The museum entries agree on the 1747 order and the Beihai holding; the block count and the number of included works come from the press feature alone.
review.noteZh: 草稿记录，依据 2026-11-23 阅读的故宫两处条目与《中国日报》报道整理。故宫两处在 1747 年上谕与北海藏石上一致；刻石方数与收录件数仅见于报道。

notes: The Palace Museum's rubbing entry says the compendium takes in more than 3,400 pieces; the press feature counts 340 works by 135 calligraphers and 495 stone blocks. The two totals are an order of magnitude apart and neither is asserted in a field.
The work is a compilation, not a single composition: its reading date is the date of the compilation, not of the works it transmits.
The stones are in situ at Beihai; the palace's own rubbing in the Palace Museum is a separate object and is not recorded here.
notesZh: 故宫拓本条目称收入精品「三千四百余件」；报道则记一百三十五位书家、三百四十件作品、刻石四百九十五方。两处总数相差一个数量级，均不入结构化字段。
此帖为丛刻，非单一作品：所记年代是编刻之年，非所收书迹之作年。
帖石在北海原址；故宫所藏清拓是另一件实物，本记录不并列。

titles.en: Dedication for the Late Duke of Shiping

aliases: 比丘慧成为亡父始平公造像记

attribution.name: 孟达
attribution.note: The exhibition notice lists 孟达撰文 and 朱义章书, the pairing recorded in the inscription's colophon.
attribution.noteZh: 展览说明列「孟达撰文、朱义章书」，即题记末行所署。

attribution.name: 比丘慧成
attribution.note: The monk who had the image and the dedication made for his deceased father, the Duke of Shiping.
attribution.noteZh: 比丘慧成为亡父始平公造像并刻此记，是出资造像者。

compositionDate.note: The exhibition notice dates the dedication to 498. The year is not legible on the stone itself, and the record does not reconstruct it from the damaged date line.

works.background: Carved on the north wall of Guyang Cave at Longmen, this is the only relief-carved (阳刻) inscription among the twenty celebrated Longmen dedications: the characters and the ruled grid both stand proud of the rock. The title runs two lines of six characters; the text, ten lines of twenty. The Qing scholar Huang Yi placed it first among the Longmen inscriptions.
works.backgroundZh: 此刻位于龙门古阳洞北壁，是龙门二十品中唯一阳刻之作：字与界格均凸出石面。额二行六字，正文十行、行二十字。清乾隆间金石学者黄易将其置于龙门造像题记之首。

review.note: Draft record from a museum-supported popular feature and an exhibition notice read on 2026-11-23. Both describe the carving technique and the find site; neither is an object catalogue entry with a measured survey. The stone was not examined.
review.noteZh: 草稿记录，依据 2026-11-23 阅读的博物馆协作科普文章与展览说明。两处均述刻法与所在地，但都不是附测量的著录；未核对原石。

notes: No measured survey of the stone face is cited. The exhibition notice gives 89 × 39 cm for the rubbing held by the Longmen research institute, which is a paper size and not the rock's.
The inscription's date line is damaged; the 498 year is the one given by the exhibition notice and is recorded as documented rather than measured.
The dedication is one of the 龙门二十品, but the group is a later selection, not a physical set; the record does not treat the twenty as a single object.
notesZh: 未引石面测量。展览说明记龙门石窟研究院藏拓片长八十九、宽三十九厘米，那是纸幅，不是石面尺寸。
题记纪年一行有残；太和二十二年（498）从展览说明，记为著录年代，非据石面测得。
此记属「龙门二十品」，然二十品是后人所选，非一体实物；本记录不把二十品当作一件实物。

attribution.name: 王羲之
attribution.note: The letters are attributed to Wang Xizhi by the Tang record quoted in the exhibition report and by the museum that holds the rubbing album.
attribution.noteZh: 所引唐代记载与藏有拓本册的博物馆均以此组书信属王羲之。

compositionDate.eraLabel: 东晋永和三年至升平五年
compositionDate.note: The span is the one given by the exhibition report, which cites research dating the letters to 347–361. Individual letters are not dated in the surviving text.

works.background: A group of letters to the 益州刺史 周抚, written over about fourteen years. The Tang imperial collection mounted Wang Xizhi's letters into scrolls of one 丈二尺; 张彦远《法书要录》 records a 十七帖 of 107 lines and 943 characters. The original manuscript is lost, and the text survives through rubbings, the 弘文馆 system being the most faithful according to the exhibition report.
works.backgroundZh: 此为致益州刺史周抚的一组书信，前后约十四年。唐内府将王羲之书迹以「一丈二尺为一卷」装裱；张彦远《法书要录》记《十七帖》长一丈二尺、一百七行、九百四十三字。原墨迹已佚，今以刻本流传，据展览报道以唐弘文馆「馆本」一系最存原貌。

review.note: Draft record. The Tang description comes from an exhibition report quoting 《法书要录》; the physical witness is a thirteenth-century album in the Metropolitan Museum read through that museum's public collection API on 2026-11-23. Neither the album nor a Chinese rubbing was examined.

works.background: In 697 Wang Fangqing presented ten scrolls of letters by twenty-eight members of his family, including Wang Xizhi and Wang Xianzhi. The court's Hongwen Academy traced and ink-filled them for the imperial collection. Only this scroll survives, carrying ten letters by seven hands. It was damaged in two fires, the Ming-era Zhenshang Studio fire and a Qing fire in the Qianlong palace, and was taken to Changchun in 1922; it is now in the Liaoning Provincial Museum.

works.background: Yan Zhenqing made this shrine stele for his father Yan Weizhen in 780, three years before his death. Both faces carry 24 lines of 47 characters; each side carries 6 lines of 52. articles.zh:
碑文记楚金和尚建塔。岑勋为此事撰文，楚金又请[颜真卿](../people/yan-zhenqing.md)把正文写上碑石，碑额由徐浩题写。唐天宝十一载（752）立碑。看[现存石碑](../catalogue/duobao-ta-bei.md#stele-duobao-ta)时，可以先认出题额，再向下找正文的开头。[西安碑林博物馆藏品说明，立碑与署名段](https://beilin-museum.com/index.php?m=home&c=View&a=index&aid=147)

2024年11月2日，淮北师范大学舒柳书画协会把这通碑用作临写范本，课堂包含用笔示范。自己读图时，可接着做[认题额的练习](../notes/duobao-reading.md)。[淮北师范大学美术学院，第六次授课](https://msxy.chnu.edu.cn/xyxw/content_125348)
articles.en:
Cen Xun composed an account of the monk Chujin’s pagoda. Chujin invited [Yan Zhenqing](../people/yan-zhenqing.md) to write the inscription, and Xu Hao wrote the heading. The stone was erected in 752. On [the surviving stone](../catalogue/duobao-ta-bei.md#stele-duobao-ta), locate the heading before following the text below. [Xi’an Beilin Museum, inscription and credits](https://beilin-museum.com/index.php?m=home&c=View&a=index&aid=147)

A calligraphy society at Huaibei Normal University used the inscription in a copying class on 2 November 2024, with a demonstration of brush movements. Try [reading the heading](../notes/duobao-reading.md) alongside the museum entry. [Faculty activity report, sixth session](https://msxy.chnu.edu.cn/xyxw/content_125348)

articles.zh:
要找[沈尹默](../people/shen-yinmo.md)写给青少年的这本字帖，书名里的“甲种本”和“大楷”都值得记下。西泠印社所载年表将上海教育出版社出版这本字帖一事列于1962年。同条还列有他写的另一本小楷字帖。姜涛谈沈尹默晚年在上海教人习字，也分别列出了这两种书。[西泠印社年表，1962年条](https://www.xlys.org.cn/wenku/www/202205/17174437ptfn.pdf) · [姜涛，第二节论青少年习字](https://shufa.pku.edu.cn/whsf/8dc5e55fd0e445a781a861c438b81cf9.htm)

若你手边有一本，可先抄下封面题名，再翻版权页核对出版年月、版次和印次。年表在1962年条内还引了一则展览报道，其中把供青少年的大小楷字帖泛称为前一年出版；报道没有逐种列名。初版的具体年月、印次和可辨认的馆藏册仍待用书本核实。[西泠印社年表，1962年条内的展览报道](https://www.xlys.org.cn/wenku/www/202205/17174437ptfn.pdf)

目前所引材料解释了当初给谁编写。仍想找到一份当代课程书单或课堂记录，能指出具体使用了这部甲种本，以及老师选了哪一页供学生临写。
articles.en:
Two details identify [Shen Yinmo](../people/shen-yinmo.md)’s copybook for young learners: the designation 甲种本 (edition A) and the large regular script. A chronology hosted by the Xiling Seal Art Society lists its publication by Shanghai Education Publishing House under 1962. The same entry names a separate small-script book. Jiang Tao identifies both titles in his study of Shen’s later work in Shanghai. [Xiling chronology, 1962 entry](https://www.xlys.org.cn/wenku/www/202205/17174437ptfn.pdf) · [Jiang Tao, second section](https://shufa.pku.edu.cn/whsf/8dc5e55fd0e445a781a861c438b81cf9.htm)

A reader with a copy can compare its cover title, imprint, edition and printing. Under 1962 the chronology also quotes a contemporary exhibition report that dates books for young learners to the preceding year without naming each title. The first publication month, printing and an identifiable library copy still need evidence from an actual volume. [Exhibition report quoted in the 1962 entry](https://www.xlys.org.cn/wenku/www/202205/17174437ptfn.pdf)

These sources establish the intended audience. A recent syllabus or class record naming this edition and the pages assigned would document its use by learners today.

articles.zh:
颜勤礼是书写者的曾祖父。唐大历十四年（779），[颜真卿](../people/yan-zhenqing.md)为他撰文并书写神道碑。今天从拓本上读到的文字，把两个人的名字留在了一起。[西安碑林博物馆藏品说明](https://www.beilin-museum.com/index.php?a=index&aid=2582&c=View&m=home)

故宫图录中的新00045406是一册民国拓本。看图时可以先记下这个编号，再分别翻阅[纸本拓册](../catalogue/yan-qinli-bei.md#dpm-rubbing-xin00045406)和[西安原石](../catalogue/yan-qinli-bei.md#yan-qinli-original-stele)的经历。纸上的某个字究竟留下了哪一时的石面？可以从[碑背的“故”字](../notes/yan-qinli-story.md)读起。[故宫藏品号与简介](https://www.dpm.org.cn/collection/impres/234175.html)

这方碑仍有人拿来临写。2024年11月6日，淮北师范大学舒柳书画协会用它上了一堂临摹课。学院的记录点出了碑名，课堂所用拓本的版本还有待辨认。[美术学院活动简报，第七次授课](https://msxy.chnu.edu.cn/xyxw/content_125348)
articles.en:
[Yan Zhenqing](../people/yan-zhenqing.md) composed and wrote this inscription for his great-grandfather Yan Qinli in 779. Both names belong to the stone, each in a different role. [Xi’an Beilin Museum, object description](https://www.beilin-museum.com/index.php?a=index&aid=2582&c=View&m=home)

The Palace Museum entry numbered 新00045406 describes a Republican-era paper album. Follow [that impression](../catalogue/yan-qinli-bei.md#dpm-rubbing-xin00045406) and [the stone in Xi’an](../catalogue/yan-qinli-bei.md#yan-qinli-original-stele) separately. For a way to ask which state of a stone an impression preserves, start with [the character 故 on its back](../notes/yan-qinli-story.md). [Palace Museum, number and description](https://www.dpm.org.cn/collection/impres/234175.html)

On 6 November 2024 a calligraphy society at Huaibei Normal University taught a copying session using the inscription. The faculty report identifies the work. The edition used by the class remains open. [Faculty activity report, seventh session](https://msxy.chnu.edu.cn/xyxw/content_125348)

articles.titleZh: 行书跋沈尹默论书札卷
articles.titleEn: Colophon to Shen Yinmo’s Writing on Calligraphy
articles.zh:
1976年，[赵朴初](../people/zhao-puchu.md)在[沈尹默](../people/shen-yinmo.md)的论书札后题跋，追念这位曾与他以诗词相和的朋友。上博将赵所写的这一段定为行书，记为高20.8厘米、宽10.0厘米。沈氏原札另记尺寸，书写年月尚待查明。[上海博物馆，详细年代、尺寸与简介](https://www.shanghaimuseum.net/mu/frontend/pg/article/id/CI00160807)

读题名时，可先在“跋”字两侧分别写下两个人的名字。再核对馆方的尺寸栏，看看各自对应卷上的哪一段。
articles.en:
In 1976 [Zhao Puchu](../people/zhao-puchu.md) added a colophon to [Shen Yinmo](../people/shen-yinmo.md)’s writing on calligraphy in memory of the friend who had exchanged poems with him. The Shanghai Museum describes Zhao’s contribution as running script, 20.8 cm high by 10.0 cm wide. It records separate measurements for Shen’s text. Its writing date remains open. [Shanghai Museum, date, measurements and description](https://www.shanghaimuseum.net/mu/frontend/pg/article/id/CI00160807)

In the Chinese title, write one name on each side of 跋 (colophon). Match each name to a section of the scroll using the catalogue’s measurements.

articles.zh: 神龙本卷后项元汴题记将摹写归于冯承素。故宫博物院在藏品说明中对这一归名及神龙印的年代提出疑问，因此本项目把冯承素列作有争议的摹写者，而不把归名当作定论。
articles.en: Xiang Yuanbian’s colophon on the Shenlong copy attributes the copying to Feng Chengsu. The Palace Museum questions both that attribution and the date of the Shenlong seal, so the project records Feng as a disputed copyist rather than a settled one.

articles.zh:
给年轻人谈学书时，沈尹默一面写讲解，一面为他们写范字。姜涛记述，1962年《人民教育》刊有他讨论毛笔练习的文章。他编写的[《甲种本大楷习字帖》](../works/shen-yinmo-dakai-jia.md)由上海教育出版社出版。沿着这一本书，可以把他的教育工作落实到一个可辨认的版本。[姜涛，晚年居沪一节](https://shufa.pku.edu.cn/whsf/8dc5e55fd0e445a781a861c438b81cf9.htm)

他和[赵朴初](zhao-puchu.md)还用诗词相答。沈氏年表在1965年条中把一次唱和放在《兰亭序》真伪讨论的背景下。日后赵朴初在沈氏论书札后题跋，那篇[写于1976年的跋](../works/zhao-puchu-shen-colophon.md)留住了朋友追念他的一个瞬间。[西泠印社年表，1965年条](https://www.xlys.org.cn/wenku/www/202205/17174437ptfn.pdf) · [上海博物馆，题跋简介](https://www.shanghaimuseum.net/mu/frontend/pg/article/id/CI00160807)

两处记载对沈氏卒年有出入。年表列在1971年，上海博物馆的赵跋简介写作1972年。这项分歧保留在此，读者可以分别核对。[年表，1971年条](https://www.xlys.org.cn/wenku/www/202205/17174437ptfn.pdf) · [上博藏品简介](https://www.shanghaimuseum.net/mu/frontend/pg/article/id/CI00160807)
articles.en:
Shen Yinmo gave young learners both accounts of brush practice and characters to copy. Jiang Tao records a 1962 article by Shen in the education journal 人民教育. Shanghai Education Publishing House published his [large regular-script copybook, edition A](../works/shen-yinmo-dakai-jia.md). Together they give a concrete starting point for studying his teaching. [Jiang Tao, section on Shen’s later years in Shanghai](https://shufa.pku.edu.cn/whsf/8dc5e55fd0e445a781a861c438b81cf9.htm)

Shen and [Zhao Puchu](zhao-puchu.md) also answered one another in verse. A chronology places an exchange in 1965 amid debate about the authenticity of the Lanting Preface. Zhao later remembered Shen in a [1976 colophon](../works/zhao-puchu-shen-colophon.md) attached to Shen’s writing about calligraphy. [Xiling chronology, 1965 entry](https://www.xlys.org.cn/wenku/www/202205/17174437ptfn.pdf) · [Shanghai Museum, colophon description](https://www.shanghaimuseum.net/mu/frontend/pg/article/id/CI00160807)

The chronology records Shen’s death in 1971. The Shanghai Museum description gives 1972. Both readings are retained here for comparison. [Chronology, 1971 entry](https://www.xlys.org.cn/wenku/www/202205/17174437ptfn.pdf) · [Museum description](https://www.shanghaimuseum.net/mu/frontend/pg/article/id/CI00160807)

articles.zh: 《兰亭序》传统上归于王羲之。故宫博物院将神龙本列为唐摹本，并在同一页面讨论摹者与神龙印的年代。读这一页时，可把“王羲之其文”与“某位唐人摹写”分开记。
articles.en: The Preface to the Orchid Pavilion is traditionally attributed to Wang Xizhi. The Palace Museum catalogues the Shenlong copy as a Tang manuscript copy and discusses both the copyist and the date of the Shenlong seal. Keep the author and the later copyist as separate claims.

articles.zh: 故宫博物院《明拓东汉礼器碑》条目引翁方纲说，认为碑文由七人书写。这是有出处的学术意见；本项目不据此生成七名确定书家。
articles.en: The Palace Museum’s entry for the Ming rubbing of the Liqi Stele cites Weng Fanggang’s view that seven people wrote the inscription. It is a sourced scholarly opinion; the project does not turn it into seven established calligraphers.

articles.zh: 《祭侄文稿》卷后鲜于枢两跋都记从曹彦礼处得卷，但丙戌署款跋记壬午（1282），戊子署款跋记癸未（1283）。两说并列，不合并为一个确定年份，也不据此补出交接地点。
articles.en: Two colophons by Xianyu Shu on the Draft Requiem both say that he received the scroll from Cao Yanli, but the bingxu colophon gives 1282 and the wuzi colophon gives 1283. The project keeps both readings and does not supply a place of transfer.

articles.zh:
读颜真卿，可以先并看两方碑。在写寺院建塔的[《多宝塔感应碑》](../works/duobao-ta-bei.md)里，文字出自岑勋，颜真卿应楚金之请书丹。看颜书之前，先在图上找徐浩写的碑额，便能分清同一块石上两个人的笔迹。[西安碑林博物馆，多宝塔感应碑](https://beilin-museum.com/index.php?m=home&c=View&a=index&aid=147)

到了家族的[《颜勤礼碑》](../works/yan-qinli-bei.md)，撰文、书写都由颜真卿承担。碑题里的颜勤礼是他的曾祖父。从一通碑读到另一通，连着问“谁撰、谁书、写给谁”，两篇文字的来由就清楚了。[西安碑林博物馆，颜勤礼碑](https://www.beilin-museum.com/index.php?a=index&aid=2582&c=View&m=home)

还可以沿三种不同的载体读颜书。浯溪崖壁上的[《大唐中兴颂》](../catalogue/datang-zhongxing-song.md)由元结撰文、颜真卿书写。台北故宫著录的[《祭侄文稿》](../catalogue/jizhi.md)是一卷行书，馆方释文标出了涂改处。北京故宫的[《麻姑仙坛记》](../catalogue/magu.md)则可循翻刻的拓本去读。[湖南省政府，浯溪碑林「历史寻迹」](https://hunan.gov.cn/hnszf/c101484/202108/t20210830_20409590.html) · [台北故宫，藏品基本资料与释文](https://digitalarchive.npm.gov.tw/Collection/Detail/3?dep=P) · [北京故宫，麻姑仙坛记](https://www.dpm.org.cn/collection/impres/234172.html)
articles.en:
Two steles offer a way into Yan Zhenqing’s work. For the [Duobao Pagoda Stele](../works/duobao-ta-bei.md), Cen Xun composed the text and the monk Chujin invited Yan to write it. Xu Hao wrote the heading. Look for it first to distinguish the two hands on the stone. [Xi’an Beilin Museum, Duobao entry](https://beilin-museum.com/index.php?m=home&c=View&a=index&aid=147)

For the [Stele of Yan Qinli](../works/yan-qinli-bei.md), Yan Zhenqing both composed and wrote the text, commemorating his great-grandfather. Asking who composed each inscription, who wrote it and whom it concerns brings its occasion into view. [Xi’an Beilin Museum, Yan Qinli entry](https://www.beilin-museum.com/index.php?a=index&aid=2582&c=View&m=home)

Three other works let us follow his writing across different surfaces. At Wuxi, Yuan Jie’s [Eulogy of the Tang Restoration](../catalogue/datang-zhongxing-song.md) was carved on a cliff in Yan’s hand. The National Palace Museum in Taipei transcribes cancelled words in Yan’s running-script [Draft Requiem for a Nephew](../catalogue/jizhi.md). The Palace Museum in Beijing catalogues the [Record of the Immortal Altar](../catalogue/magu.md) in an impression taken from a recarving. [Hunan government, Wuxi account](https://hunan.gov.cn/hnszf/c101484/202108/t20210830_20409590.html) · [National Palace Museum, scroll and transcription](https://digitalarchive.npm.gov.tw/Collection/Detail/3?dep=P) · [Palace Museum, Magu entry](https://www.dpm.org.cn/collection/impres/234172.html)

articles.zh:
在上海博物馆著录的一卷书迹中，赵朴初接着故友的字写下了自己的话。卷前是[沈尹默](shen-yinmo.md)的论书札，赵朴初用行书写的[卷后题跋](../works/zhao-puchu-shen-colophon.md)作于1976年。馆方分别量出沈书和赵跋的尺寸，翻看藏品说明时可以据此辨认两段。[上海博物馆，尺寸与简介](https://www.shanghaimuseum.net/mu/frontend/pg/article/id/CI00160807)

这卷书迹之前，两人已有诗词往来。西泠印社所载年表给了一个可追索的题目：1965年，两人因《兰亭序》真伪之议而有唱和。[年表，1965年条](https://www.xlys.org.cn/wenku/www/202205/17174437ptfn.pdf)
articles.en:
On a scroll catalogued by the Shanghai Museum, Zhao Puchu added his own words after those of his friend [Shen Yinmo](shen-yinmo.md). Shen’s text discusses calligraphy. Zhao’s [running-script colophon](../works/zhao-puchu-shen-colophon.md) dates to 1976. The museum gives separate measurements for the two contributions. [Shanghai Museum, measurements and description](https://www.shanghaimuseum.net/mu/frontend/pg/article/id/CI00160807)

The friends had exchanged poems before the colophon was written. A chronology identifies the debate over the authenticity of the Lanting Preface as the subject of an exchange in 1965. [Xiling chronology, 1965 entry](https://www.xlys.org.cn/wenku/www/202205/17174437ptfn.pdf)

articles.titleZh: 读《多宝塔碑》时，先找碑额上的“塔”
articles.titleEn: Find the character 塔 in the Duobao heading
articles.zh:
读帖练习由 Codex 拟写，供读者依图复看。

打开[《多宝塔感应碑》](../works/duobao-ta-bei.md)的馆方图版与说明。西安碑林著录，额上的“大唐多宝塔感应碑”为徐浩所书，书体是隶书；正文由颜真卿书丹。读碑时先找额题里的“塔”，用手在纸上标出它在题名中的位置。[馆方图版及题额说明](https://beilin-museum.com/index.php?m=home&c=View&a=index&aid=147)

再从正文里选一个看得清的字，在另一格临写。给两格各注书者、字在碑上的位置。若手上的字帖只截取了正文，可写下它的书名和页码，回到馆方整碑图补看题额。换一位读者，能否循你的标注在图上找到同一处？
articles.en:
A looking exercise drafted by Codex. Check it against the museum illustrations.

Open the museum entry for the [Duobao Pagoda Stele](../works/duobao-ta-bei.md). It identifies the clerical-script heading as Xu Hao’s and the body text as Yan Zhenqing’s. Locate 塔 in the heading 大唐多宝塔感应碑 and mark its position in the title on paper. [Museum illustrations and account of the heading](https://beilin-museum.com/index.php?m=home&c=View&a=index&aid=147)

Choose one legible character from the body text and copy it in a second square. Label each square with its writer and its place on the stone. If your copybook crops the heading, record the book and page, then consult the museum’s view of the stone. Could a second reader find the same characters from your labels?

articles.titleZh: 从一个「故」字读《颜勤礼碑》
articles.titleEn: Reading the Yan Qinli Stele through a single character
articles.zh:
临《颜勤礼碑》，可以先留意碑背的一个「故」字。颜真卿为曾祖父颜勤礼撰文并书写的这通碑，立于唐大历十四年（779）。一千多年后，恰好穿过这个字的一道断口，让人得以追看碑石重见天日以后的经历。 [碑林藏品说明](https://www.beilin-museum.com/index.php?a=index&aid=2582&c=View&m=home) · [碑林移碑记述](https://www.beilin-museum.com/index.php?a=index&aid=2440&c=View&m=home)

1922 年 10 月，工人在西安修整省长公署的地基时掘出了断成两截的碑石。西安碑林博物馆的文章记载，有人就在坑边取拓；当时两截石头还能对上，「故」字的笔画也能接起来。数日后，碑立到公署前院，字的断处已合不拢了。 [碑林移碑记述](https://www.beilin-museum.com/index.php?a=index&aid=2440&c=View&m=home)

1928 年春，碑迁到新城，成为当地「小碑林」的一部分。馆方记述，此时「故」只剩几笔。1948 年，这批碑石又迁入西安碑林。临写时若遇到残笔，可以先问一句：我眼前这一笔，留下的是笔锋，还是石头后来受过的伤？ [碑林移碑记述](https://www.beilin-museum.com/index.php?a=index&aid=2440&c=View&m=home)

再翻故宫的藏品目录，同一个碑名下是一册纸本，编号新00045406。馆方列出册页图，并引录旧目录里的装裱和购价信息，只将拓制年代定为民国。我们还不知道这册具体拓于哪一年、何时入藏，也没有依据把它认作当年坑边拓下的那一份。 [故宫藏品简介](https://www.dpm.org.cn/collection/impres/234175.html)
articles.en:
Look for the character 故 on the back of the Yan Qinli Stele. Yan Zhenqing composed and wrote the inscription for his great-grandfather Yan Qinli. The stone was erected in 779. More than a thousand years later, a break running through that one character would help tell the story of the stone after its rediscovery. [Beilin object entry](https://www.beilin-museum.com/index.php?a=index&aid=2582&c=View&m=home) · [Beilin account of the transfers](https://www.beilin-museum.com/index.php?a=index&aid=2440&c=View&m=home)

In October 1922, workers repairing the foundations of the governor’s compound in Xi’an uncovered the stone in two pieces. According to the Beilin Museum, people took impressions at the edge of the pit. The halves still fitted together, joining the strokes of 故. A few days later, when the stone stood in the front courtyard, the broken edges of the character no longer met. [Beilin account of the transfers](https://www.beilin-museum.com/index.php?a=index&aid=2440&c=View&m=home)

In spring 1928 the stone moved to Xincheng, where it became part of a small collection of steles. The museum recounts that only a few strokes of 故 remained. In 1948 the collection moved to the Xi’an Beilin. When a stroke breaks off in your copybook, consider what its edge preserves: the movement of the brush, or later damage to the stone? [Beilin account of the transfers](https://www.beilin-museum.com/index.php?a=index&aid=2440&c=View&m=home)

Under the same title, the Palace Museum catalogues a paper album, number 新00045406. Its entry shows the leaves and quotes an earlier catalogue on mounting and purchase prices. The museum dates the impression to the Republican era. Its precise year and accession date remain open, as does any connection to the impressions taken beside the pit. [Palace Museum catalogue](https://www.dpm.org.cn/collection/impres/234175.html)
